name: Polina
self_text: Hey! I’m a 50‑something Chilean who loves growing chillies and shooting with a Canon. I’d love a structured instruction session at a relaxed pace, with plenty of gear talk. I’m happy to teach post‑processing too. I’m free on Saturday mornings or Sunday afternoons—let’s chat and plan a chill, learning‑filled day!

requests.request_text: I need you to be available on either Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon. I'd strongly prefer that you are the one who learns post‑processing from me, though it’s not a requirement. A nice bonus would be if you are into a structured instruction session.
